jobs.description:
As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?

 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for reach truck drivers (with and without experience) who can work dayshifts.

• You will correctly handle goods for the customer in the warehouse. Accuracy and attention to detail are very important.

• You will be responsible for loading/unloading in the warehouse using a reach truck.

• You will use a scanning system to pick the correct goods.

• You will also use a manual transpallet or an electric transpallet to move the picked goods.

• You will work independently according to imposed procedures.

 

• Attestation reach truck

• Very good English knowledge and basic NL OR very good NL.

• You want a long-term commitment.

• You are flexible in terms of tasks, occasionally supporting order picking is also necessary!

• Working dayshifts, starting between 6h and 10h + also flexible to work on Saturdays occasionally

• Eye for detail to accurately record numerical codes and perform quality checks

• Logistical insight

• Good physical condition to manually take the goods from the racks and put them on the transpallet

• Own transport or via Maxmobiel from Dampoort Station

This international company specializes in the manufacturing and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, producing high-quality injection-molded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.	
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.	
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.	
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.	
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.	
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

	
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).	
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.	
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.	
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.	
• You have a good command of Dutch.	
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.	
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.	
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.	
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.	
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.	
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.	
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

jobs.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Press & Media

¿ With the support of the wider JDFoE Foundation team, develop and execute media strategies for each capital roadshow event, including targeted outreach to EU-level and national press, preparation of press releases, briefing documents and media packs

¿ Manage accreditation and on-site press logistics for events; provide real-time media support during events and coordinate rapid response where needed

¿ Build and maintain a journalist database covering Single Market and EU competitiveness beats, both with EU-focused publications and national journalists

¿ Monitor media coverage, prepare press reviews after each event and maintain a running record of articles and interviews featuring the Foundation, Enrico Letta and OEOM campaign themes;

¿ Contribute to wider strategic discussions on media performance

¿ Monitor the EU legislative and policy calendar, as well as other stakeholders' communications activity, to identify and plan proactive press moments ¿ including feeding into the drafting of quotes or statements and ensuring their distribution to journalists in advance of or in response to key Commission or Council decisions relevant to the OEOM roadmap

¿ Coordinate media requests and interview scheduling for key spokespersons in the context of the roadshow, liaising directly with their team and advisors

¿ With the support of the wider JDFoE Foundation team, develop and maintain a suite of key messages assets for the Foundation, the OEOM roadshow and the Letta report (including key facts and figures), keeping them current with campaign developments and EU policy milestones; maintain a Foundation boilerplate for press releases

Social Media & Digital Content

¿ Manage the JDFoE Foundation's social media presence as it relates to the One Europe, One Market campaign, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and Bluesky

¿ Develop and maintain a social media content calendar aligned with the EU legislative calendar, roadshow events and key campaign moments

¿ Draft copy for posts, graphics briefs and short-form content; following the campaign's brand guidelines on voice and visual identity in close alignment with the Multimedia Manager

¿ Manage campaign-related content on the JDFoE website, including event pages, press releases and campaign updates

Internal Coordination & Strategic Input

¿ Support the coordination of communications activities across JDFoE Foundation units, working with the FoE Communications Manager and the JDFoE Managing Director to ensure that campaign messaging is coherent and consistently applied across all external communications

¿ Align day to day activities with the FoE communications manager to ensure a coherent presence in Brussels and leverage best practices and capabilities

¿ Contribute ideas and identify best-practice examples for communications approaches, formats and channels, feeding these into wider-team discussions

¿ Work closely with the Campaign Manager to align the communications calendar with the events programme and stakeholder engagement activities

¿ Provide communications input into event scripts, partner briefings and speaker preparation materials
 
PROFILE & EXPERIENCE

¿ Minimum 3 years of experience in communications, public affairs or media relations, with experience in European policy or institutional communications

¿ Proven experience managing social media channels for a policy organisation, think tank, foundation or campaign

¿ Strong writing and editorial skills; ability to simplify complex political or economic issues, both in writing and visually

¿ Excellent mastery of English; additional EU languages a significant asset given the cross-border nature of the campaign

¿ Experience in working with EU-focused and national media; experience pitching and placing stories with quality press and specialist EU outlets a plus

¿ Previous experience with Cision or similar is a must; Canva design capabilities to produce basic visuals (e.g. for social media posts) is an asset

¿ Proactive, highly-motivated and well-organised personality that is open to use AI-tools for greater speed and efficiency whilst maintaining an original voice

¿ Passionate about Europe, familiarity with economic issues, the European Single Market policy agenda and the broader EU competitiveness debate is an asset.
 
Contract type Employee

FTE 100%

Level Executive

Salary Starting at €2 782 / month, additional benefits - learn more about them here

Duration Open-ended

Location Brussels-based; travel to events might be required

Reporting to Managing Director, JDFoE Foundation; functional reporting to FoE Communications Manager

Key Responsibilities

• Patient reception: Welcome and assist patients upon arrival
• Phone management: Handle incoming calls, patient inquiries, and appointment requests
• Schedule coordination: Organise and update practitioners' schedules (appointments, emergencies, reminders via email/SMS)
• Administrative communication: Communicate with patients, insurance funds, laboratories, and suppliers
• Document handling: Process patient records, forms, and insurance documentation accurately
• Practice support: Assist the team with daily operational tasks to ensure smooth workflow 
• Rigorous, motivated, friendly, and dynamic
• Strong organisational and administrative skills
• Able to work autonomously and take initiative
• Excellent command of English (required); Dutch is highly desirable
• Knowledge of Arabic or Romanian is an asset
• Previous experience in a medical or dental environment is desirable
• Good computer skills (agenda software, email, basic administration) 
Contract Details

• Initial contract: full-time (37h/week)
• Working hours: Monday to Friday between 09:30 and 17:30
